title: plugin-form draws `{ name }` field entries and inline runtime-field section entries that objectstack's form view refuses; the page-builder guide teaches the field form and its extra keys are dropped
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect**, finding class: two doors over one contract disagree. `reach:` a named producer, this repo's published page-builder guide (below). Filed from objectstack's `domain:spec` seat 2 (`session_01YDt3PzwfrkuFzUBF89WPmM`, objectstack seat post #18549), from the stage-3 dev report of objectstack-ai/objectstack#21464 (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#21590), measured at this repo's pin `89cad75d55` by objectstack's `.objectui-sha`. ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading are this repo's triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Measured (at `89cad75d55`)

**`object-form` `fields`**
- Read at `packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx:961-981` (the field pool) and `flatFields.ts:71-79` (the drawer and modal arms). An entry is a string, **or an object drawn by its `name`**.
- This repo declares the member as `string[]`, yet draws `{ name }` entries. They are pinned as behaviour in `__tests__/objectFormFieldsMembers-8071.test.tsx:165-167`, and authored in `fieldSecurityPayload.test.tsx:214`, `:222`, `:230` and `systemManagedPayload.test.tsx:209`.
- **The producer:** `skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md:263`, an `os:check` example, teaches `fields: [{ name, label, type, required }, …]`. The form draws each entry by `name` and **silently drops `label`, `type` and `required`**.

**`object-form` `sections`**
- `sectionFields.ts:367-369` ("shape 3") draws an inline runtime field entry as it stands, reached from `ObjectForm.tsx:364`, `:1518` and every sectioned arm.
- objectstack's form view (`FormViewSchema.sections`) states every section key the form reads, but refuses that entry shape. Writers that draw it: `plugin-form/README.md:764` (a wizard with inline runtime fields), and `submitTargetRefusal.test.tsx:345` and `:374`.

**`object-master-detail-form` `fields` and `sections`**
- `MasterDetailForm.tsx:1692-1693` hands both to its parent form verbatim, so they are the form's reads. `__tests__/topLevelFieldsWarnCoverage-8847.test.tsx:254-257` draws `[{ name: 'note' }, 'status']`.

**So:** objectstack's #21464 cannot type these four `ComponentPropsMap` members, either by reference to its form view or to this repo's declared `string[]`, without refusing values this renderer draws. Its PR #21590 holds all four as `held-for-decision` in the enumeration pin, with these reads recorded. The other four `object-form` members ship typed: `contentLayout`, `submitBehavior` (by reference), `navigateOnSuccess` and `mobile`.

## The two directions (⛔ not a ruling)

- **Retire the read here:** `fields` takes names only, and section field entries take the spec's form (keyed by `field`). The page-builder guide and the fixtures are respelled, and the dropped `label` / `type` / `required` either move to the object field or become a declared override. objectstack can then type the four members by reference.
- **Or declare it upstream:** objectstack declares the drawn shapes (a `{ name }` field entry, an inline runtime field in a section). That widens its form view and needs its own ruling there.

Either way, the authored-writer measurement comes first. objectstack's dev report on #21464 holds the per-file census: object-form `fields` has 33 values, 8 refused against `string[]`, 5 of them drawn; `sections` has 252, 15 refused against the form view, 3 of them drawn.

**Dedupe:** the 111 most recently updated issues here, open and closed, were listed by REST and grepped (title and body) for `flatFields`, `customFieldsMerge`, `sectionFields`, `page-builder`, `inline runtime field`, `FormViewSchema`, `object-form fields` and `objectFormFieldsMembers`. The only hit is #9771, a seat post, not this subject. Control: `plugin-form`, 5 hits.
